Live_Measurements.description: Real-time display of incoming data from active controllers.

features.aggregation: Automatically averages data points if more than 700 points exist in the selected time span.
features.on_demand_loading: Only downloads data for the visible zoom level to save bandwidth.

Dashboard.description: Customizable page combining data views and system controls through widgets.

tabs.concept: Each tab is an independent dashboard with its own widgets and layout. Every widget belongs to exactly one tab. Used to separate screens by purpose (e.g. per greenhouse or per function).

management.create: '+' button at the left of the tab strip.
management.rename_delete_duplicate_lock: Gear (settings) icon opens 'Dashboard Settings'. Duplicate copies the tab and all its widgets. Deleting the last tab auto-creates a new one. Lock/Unlock is per-tab and freezes the arrangement.
management.reorder: Drag tabs left/right; order saves automatically.
management.add_widget: When the tab is unlocked, pick a widget type and 'Add Widget'; it lands on the current tab.
management.move_widget_between_tabs: Open a widget's gear icon and choose another tab in the 'Tab' dropdown.

AoT_map.name: AoT Map
AoT_map.purpose: Shows devices on an interactive MapLibre GL map, highlighting operating state by color; supports GIS overlay layers and 3D facility rendering.
key_options: 3D terrain, pitch, bearing, facility render mode
device filter: Input/Output/Function devices to HIDE from the map (exclude-list; empty = show every placed device)
AoT_map.notable: Realtime sensor values anchored on 3D structures; shows latest AI advisories as clickable chips when global AI is configured. Clicking a Zone/Site shape opens a popup listing its sensors and output devices, each output with an On/Off toggle and a 'Settings' button to schedule a start/end time (a future start time is timed client-side by the open browser tab, not the server).

widget_trigger_sequence.name: Sequence Controller
widget_trigger_sequence.purpose: Activates, deactivates, and monitors a Sequence function (trigger_sequence), showing its action list and schedule.
key_options: synced sequence settings: start/end time, cycle period, startup delay, step crossing time
widget_trigger_sequence.notable: Body shows a weekly schedule with per-weekday enable checkboxes editable from the dashboard.

AoT_timer.name: AoT Timer
AoT_timer.purpose: Toggle switches the output on/off directly. Turning on the 'Timer' option adds timed operation: Simple mode (default) runs once for a set h/m/s duration (0 = run until stopped), Cycle mode repeats a Run/Rest sequence for a set number of cycles, and 'Scheduled Start' begins at a wall-clock time in the device timezone. With 'Timer' off, the toggle ignores all time settings and is a plain on/off switch.
key_options: Timer (on/off — enables the timed controls below)
operation mode: Simple (default, single run) or Cycle (run/rest repeated)
AoT_timer.notable: Server-side worker drives ON/OFF cycles and survives app restarts (scheduled timers re-armed).

widget_calendar.name: Calendar
widget_calendar.purpose: Shows scheduled events (from the Scheduler) on a calendar, split into AI/User/Device categories, plus any Google calendars connected via two-way sync.
key_options: default view: Month/Week/List (auto-switches to List on narrow widgets)
which AoT categories + connected Google calendars are visible (per-widget calendar picker)
widget_calendar.notable: Click an event to view/edit, or drag to reschedule; edit modal includes a location map preview. Scheduling a device action from a calendar event creates it pending approval, same as other AI-mutating actions.

AoT_graph.name: AoT Graph
AoT_graph.purpose: Synchronous time-series graph (Highcharts Stock) plotting selected measurements over a configured window.
key_options: time axis: refresh, X-axis duration + unit, auto-refresh, live-window reset
style toggles: header buttons, title, navigator, export, range selector, legend
AoT_graph.notable: On-demand history loading via range buttons (1m..3mo/All) or zoom; Reset returns to the live sliding window.

AoT_gauge_angular.name: AoT Circular Gauge
AoT_gauge_angular.purpose: Shows one measurement on a circular gauge with colored bands.
AoT_gauge_angular.notable: Presets auto-set min/max and follow the global 5-band palette (Settings > Custom UI); Maximum Value must match the top (High) section.
